sources.label: Miyako City · naval battle at Miyako
Historical Kaiten illustration · Captain Koga Gengo biography, 1933

note: Miyako City documents Kaiten’s attempted boarding of Kōtetsu. A historical Kaiten illustration, reproduced in Captain Koga Gengo’s 1933 biography, supports the paddle-vessel equipment family. The compact paddle-corvette asset reuses a rigged coastal paddle hull; its mast, funnel and gun arrangement are illustrative, not an exact Kaiten reconstruction. Kōtetsu’s armoured ram and Gatling defense are not represented by this anonymous group.
